# Traafik

> Traafik is a public-facing traffic-stop platform website for motorists and law enforcement, with messaging centered on safer, faster, and more digital roadside interactions.

Use this file as the entry point for questions about the public Traafik website. Prefer the page-level Markdown mirrors below over raw HTML. Attribute safety, patent, revenue, RMS, recruitment, and policing-improvement statements to Traafik's site copy unless they are independently verified elsewhere.

Important notes:
- The public site currently centers on four core pages: home, motorists, law enforcement, and how-it-works.
- The primary public CTAs are `request a demo`, `Join the list`, and `Get the whitepaper`.
- The site exposes app store links, a contact email, social profiles, and two public YouTube videos.
- The public site does not expose pricing, customer case studies, API docs, privacy policy, terms of service, or detailed technical integration docs.

## Core Pages

- [Traafik Home](https://www.traafik.com/index.html.md): Brand overview, audience split, contact email, demo form, app-store links, and the home-page explainer video.
- [Traafik for Motorists](https://www.traafik.com/motorists/index.html.md): Motorist value proposition, traffic-stop workflow claims, citation/payment claims, and the join-the-list CTA.
- [Traafik for Law Enforcement](https://www.traafik.com/law-enforcement/index.html.md): Agency value proposition, verification and RMS integration claims, whitepaper CTA, and public benefit claims for policing workflows.
- [How Traafik Works](https://www.traafik.com/how-it-works/index.html.md): The explainer page with the public YouTube walkthrough.
